; REQ: LANG-341 LANG-342 LANG-343 LANG-344 LANG-345
(ns demo.greeter
  (:require [clojure.string :as str]))

(def ^:dynamic *greeting* "Hello")

(defn greet
  "Greets name times times."
  [name times]
  (let [text (str *greeting* ", " name "!\n")
        pattern #"\d+ \"quoted\""]
    (if (pos? times)
      (apply str (repeat times text))
      :none)))

(defn- valid? [x]
  (and (not (nil? x)) (re-find #"[a-z]+" x)))

(def config {:name "world" :times 2 ::internal true})

(defmacro unless [test & body]
  `(if ~test nil (do ~@body)))

(println (greet (:name config) (:times config)) 0x1F 1.5 1/3 true false nil)
(swap! (atom 0) inc)
